title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 449 (Punishment for false evidence)

content.overview: A person who intentionally gives false evidence on oath or affirmation, before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal, is punishable with imprisonment and fine.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: A person who intentionally gives false evidence on oath or affirmation, before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal, is punishable with imprisonment and fine.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The offence is perjury before the company-law fora. It is additional to the Contempt of Courts Act.
